metadata.datasource: ILFORD XP2 SUPER fact sheet (January 2001), vector paths: spectral sensitivity (p2) and characteristic curve (p2). Copy from 125px.com's archive of ILFORD documents.

tags.log_sensitivity: SHEET 354-660 nm: the "wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2850K)" taken as drawn; ASSUMED its 0-1 "Sensitivity" axis is log units and the source is not divided out (as HP5 Plus); the 2001 sheet's ordinate has no ticks: 1.0 placed 27.4 pt below the frame top, 0 at its bottom, as on the November 2018 sheet's raster chart; ASSUMED held below 354 nm, ASSUMED log-linear tail -0.0242 dex/nm above 660 nm; scale MEASURED so grey 0.184 -> raw 1
tags.density_curves: SHEET for log_exposure -2.06..2.20 (C-41: the one curve the sheet plots; slope 0.3-1.5 over base+fog 0.589); ASSUMED flat toe below, ASSUMED straight line slope 0.099 into a ceiling of gross D 3.0 above
tags.log_exposure_anchor: ASSUMED: the sheet's exposure axis is relative. 0 = one log unit above the curve's own D = base+fog + 0.1 point, i.e. the film is taken to have exactly its rated speed (ISO 400: log10(0.8/400)+1.0 = -1.699 log lux-s)
tags.channel_density: ASSUMED: neutral, 1/3 per channel at every wavelength (XP2 Super's image is dye, not silver; the sheet gives no dye spectrum)
tags.density_curves_layers: ASSUMED: three-CDF fit of the curve (max fit error 0.0099 D), no sheet data on emulsion sub-layers
